systems.name: creative-apps
systems.description: Flare's slice of creative-apps: every L3 component Flare v1 needs (docs/blueprints/flare.md sections 2 and 7, and the packets in docs/blueprints/flare/features/), each marked existing (all its paths on origin/dev 956d946) or planned (none yet).

containers.name: FlareModel
containers.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Flare's window: the workspace, the use-case contracts, their fakes and live conformances over FlareCore.

components.name: Workspace and services
components.description: FlareWorkspace, the one Sendable, Equatable value behind a window (document, engine, selected scene, tool, selection, drafts, frame and playback, auto-key, onion, symbol being edited, machine, export, assist and file state, section 2's stored-property table), the FlareCore typealiases (FlarePath, FlareColor, FlareScene, FlareShape, FlareTransition), and FlareServices: one existential per use-case contract with its .fake and .live values. toolHelp(_:) reads each tool's service for the reason a tool is off.

relationships.description: holds one conformance per use-case contract
owns the open Document and its CommandEngine

components.name: Use-case contracts
components.description: One Swift protocol per use case (section 6.2), Linux-safe, FlareCore and Foundation types only: StageRendering, StageHitTesting, ShapeBuilding, PropertyAnimating, KeyframeEditing, KeyframeEasing, OnionSkinning, SceneEditing, LibraryManaging, StateMachineEditing, StateMachinePreviewing, Exporting with its FrameRasterizing argument, and AnimationAssisting, plus the shared value types (StageAddress, StageDrawList, ShapeDraft, ExportOptions, AssistProposal and the rest). Every fake and live conformance codes against these.

components.name: Selection, drag and drawing
components.description: FlareSelection (click, Shift-click, marquee, the selection box's bounds), FlareDrag (a stage gesture changes only draft and dragPreview while the pointer moves, then commits once on mouse-up as one named undo step: Add Rectangle, Move, Scale, Rotate, Edit Path) and FlareDrawing (the Ellipse tool's draft and commit on the workspace, the stopgap until LiveShapes and LC-4's ellipse builder).

components.name: Edit menu
components.description: FlareEdit runs Cut, Copy, Paste, Duplicate, Delete, Select All and Deselect, each one named undo step (Cut composed by the workspace's step) or disabled with the reason it refuses with.

relationships.description: calls services.shapes for delete, duplicate, copy and paste

components.name: Properties, keys, easing and onion state
components.description: FlareAnimate (auto-key, the inspector's animated properties with Mixed, one coalesced step per scrub, the stopwatch and keyframe button by section 2's not-animated rule), FlareEasing with EasingEditing and FakeEasingEditing (the window-level easing editor: segments, presets, handle drags as one coalesced step), and FlareOnionState (onion skin and motion path preferences, ghosts and path read from services.onion).

relationships.description: calls services.properties, keyframes, easing and onion

components.name: Playback clock
components.description: FlarePlayback (current frame, playing, loop, advance(elapsed:), the symbol's range while editing in place) and FlarePlaybackTicks: PlaybackTicker turns display-link target timestamps into elapsed seconds, FlareWorkspace.tick is the link's entry point, and PlaybackBudget holds QB-L4's dropped-frame gate. Engine-direct over Timeline.playbackFrame.

components.name: Scenes, guides and layers
components.description: FlareScenes (add, rename, remove never the last, reorder, canvas and timing), FlareGuides (add, move as one coalesced step per drag, remove, clear) and FlareLayers (the layers panel, engine-direct: add, remove, rename, visibility, lock, order).

components.name: Symbols and swatches
components.description: FlareSymbols: the Library tab's symbols with usage counts and swatches, Convert to Symbol, place an instance, the reason Delete is off while a symbol is used, and editing a symbol in place (the owner switch, the symbol's length on the timeline, the scene frame to return to).

components.name: Interactions state and graph layout
components.description: FlareMachines (the edited machine, states from frame labels, transitions and inputs, each edit one named undo step with refusals in machineError, and the live preview, which any edit stops), FlareMachineMessages (the plain refusal text) and MachineLayout (columns by breadth-first distance from the initial state, unreachable states in a last column; the same machine always gives the same layout).

components.name: Files, Open Recent and recovery data
components.description: FlareFiles: open through load (progress first, a pure decode the app runs off the main thread, then the landing), save bytes, file name, title and dirty flag, section 3.3's alert text per FormatError, the Open Recent list (paths, most recent first, at most ten). mac-platform MP-2 and MP-3 add to this file the autosave due time, the recovery bytes and restoring a recovered document as unsaved work. FlareSampleAnimation builds the sample document the toolbar opens today.

components.name: Export options, scan and run
components.description: FlareExport (the export sheet's options, progress, cancel, result and warnings) and ExportScan (names everything an export can't write: text, symbol animation, machines, Lottie's background), so nothing is dropped silently.

relationships.description: calls services.export with the window's FrameRasterizing

components.name: Assist state
components.description: FlareAssist (LM-0c4): the Assist popover's prompt, proposal, preview list and error; Accept applies the proposal as one "Assist" undo group through the shared apply code, Reject leaves the history untouched, and a proposal that adds or edits text is rejected whole with a reason.

components.name: Fixture fakes
components.description: The fakes the UI track and snapshots run on: FakeScenes, FakeStage, FakeHits, FakeShapes, FakeProperties, FakeKeyframes, FakeEasing, FakeOnion, FakeLibrary, FakeMachines, FakePreview, FakeExport with FakeRasterizer, NotBuilt for members without a fake, FixtureEdit (a document-swapping Command, never registered), and FlareFixtures with the empty, bounce, character, button and showcase documents.

relationships.description: runs fixture edits through the real CommandEngine

components.name: Fake assist
components.description: FakeAssist (LM-0c4): canned proposals in each FakeAssistMode (already declared in AssistContracts) that the -FlareAssistMode launch argument picks, so the Assist UI ships on the fake before the suite's model provider exists.

components.name: Large fixtures
components.description: LM-0c5: the reference (20 layers, 1,000 shapes, 300 frames, 50 two-level nested instances), crowd (300 layers, 500 animated instances, 5,000 keys) and limit (9,999 layers) documents the perf journeys P1 to P7 and the model budgets run on.

components.name: Live easing
components.description: LiveEasing (LM-6): KeyframeEasing over FlareCore's SetKeyframeEasing; KY-8 (live-keys) adds the owner path for a symbol's layers.

components.name: Live stage, hits and shapes
components.description: The live-stage packet (ST-1 to ST-9): LiveStage builds the StageDrawList from the render list (paint order, opacity, cubics kept, nested instances, editing in place); LiveHits gives the topmost hit with its address, the marquee and world bounds with stroke; LiveShapes drafts and commits Rectangle, Ellipse and Pen, the box move, scale and rotate over BoxGestureMath (moved out of FakeShapes), and path edit, translate, delete, duplicate, copy and paste, each one named undo group.

relationships.description: conforms to StageRendering, StageHitTesting and ShapeBuilding
reads Scene.renderList, the hit query and world bounds

components.name: Live properties and keyframes
components.description: The live-keys packet (KY-1 to KY-7): LiveProperties reads values, key states and Mixed and writes by section 2's rule as one merged SetKeyframe per scrub, with the stopwatch, keyframe button, fill and stroke; LiveKeyframes gives the timeline rows and labels, moves and removes keys (collision and past-the-end refused) and inserts and removes frames.

relationships.description: performs owner-aware keyframe commands, merged per scrub (LC-5, LC-10)

components.name: Live scenes and guides
components.description: The live-scenes packet (SN-1 to SN-5): LiveScenes makes a new document, adds, removes (never the last), renames and reorders scenes, sets canvas and timing, and adds, moves (one merged MoveGuide per drag) and removes guides.

relationships.description: performs scene and guide commands (LC-8, LC-10)

components.name: Live onion and library
components.description: LiveOnion (LM-8: ghosts from Layer.onionFrames with falling opacity, the motion path with ticks that follow the easing) and LiveLibrary (LM-10: symbols with usage counts including nested instances, convert with an empty render diff, instance playback).

relationships.description: reads onion frames and the render list
places instances and sets their playback

components.name: Live machines and preview
components.description: LiveMachines (LM-11: machine, state, transition and input commands with refusals that name the blocking transition, issues from StateMachine.issues) and LivePreview (LM-12: the runtime player driving the active state from input changes).

relationships.description: performs machine commands and runs MachinePlayer

components.name: Live export
components.description: LiveExport (LM-13a: SVG frame, Lottie, PNG sequence through the window's rasterizer, cancellation leaves no files) and LiveExportCleaning (LM-13b: text removed from a copy before export, the scan's warnings attached; never throws for content v1 can't write).

components.name: Live assist
components.description: LiveAssist (LM-14): AnimationAssisting behind a provider protocol, unavailable with a reason until the suite's model provider exists; a provider's proposal goes through the shared apply code.

relationships.description: proposals are lists of registered commands

containers.name: FlareApp
containers.description: The Flare app on SuiteUI's EditorShell: window, intents, views, and the CoreGraphics and display-link platform files. Reads FlareModel and calls its methods.

components.name: Today's app shell
components.description: The App scene (FlareApp), the menu bar (FlareCommands), the sidebar layer rows (FlareLayerItems) and the easing inspector (FlareEasingInspector) on SuiteWindow. F1a splits FlareApp.swift onto EditorShell, F2 rebinds every FlareCommands item to a FlareIntent, F11a deletes FlareLayerItems for the Layers tab, and F9's easing popover and TIMING row take over the easing inspector.

relationships.description: reads state and calls its methods
the easing inspector calls the easing editor
the sidebar lists and edits layers
shows the scene in CanvasSurface and SurfaceCard

components.name: Stage path and playback driver
components.description: StagePath (LA-0, MP-4): FlareCore Path and Matrix to CGPath with one addCurve per cubic, document colors to CGColor(srgbRed:green:blue:alpha:), non-finite points skipped; the one conversion the stage and the rasterizer share. PlaybackDriver (LA-2): an NSScreen display link that feeds target timestamps into FlareWorkspace.tick.

relationships.description: calls FlareWorkspace.tick with each target timestamp

components.name: PNG rasterizer
components.description: StageRasterizer (LA-1): a StageDrawList to PNG at a pixel scale with CoreGraphics on StagePath, so a PNG export equals the stage picture (QB-V4). FlareWindow passes it to export when the services are live, FakeRasterizer otherwise.

components.name: Autosave and recovery
components.description: FlareAutosave (mac-platform MP-5, MP-6): RecoveryFile and the writer that polls autosaveDue, writes recoveryData atomically off the main thread, removes the file after a clean save and writes once more on quit; on launch it reads and decodes a recovery file off the main thread and offers Restore or Discard. FlareRecovery (F17c) shows the offer and the save-failure alert in the window.

relationships.description: reads autosaveDue and recoveryData, calls restoreRecovery

components.name: Window, intents and launch
components.description: FlareWindow owns the one model and presentation state (zoom, panel tab, popovers, file URL); every control sends a FlareIntent, which the router (FlareWindow+Router) hands to one FlareWindow+<Area> file. FlareLaunch reads -FlareFixture, -FlareSample, -FlareOpenFile, -FlareSaveTo, -FlareExportTo, -FlareAssistMode, -FlarePerfProbe and -FlareWindowSize (section 12.3). FlareEditor lays out EditorShell's slots; FlareControls gives every control its flare.<area>.<name> identifier and the suite.controls JSON.

relationships.description: owns one FlareWorkspace and calls its methods
lays the window out on EditorShell and EditorTopBar

components.name: Stage view
components.description: FlareStage (F3a: the draw list in one Canvas under drawingGroup, readOnly for preview), FlareStageOverlay (draft, selection, ghosts, motion path and guides in a separate overlay Canvas, so a pointer move redraws only the overlay), FlareStageSelection (F3b), FlareStageTools (F4a: Rectangle, Ellipse, Pen and their one-key shortcuts), FlareStageDirect (F4b), FlareStageGuides (F3c: zoom, pan, rulers, guides) and the Stage, Tools and View intent areas.

relationships.description: sends drag, endDrag and selection calls
draws handles with CanvasMarks and sits in CanvasViewport with rulers
draws anchors, ghosts, the motion path and guides

components.name: Inspector view
components.description: FlareInspector (F6a: title, info card, TRANSFORM bar sliders with keyframe buttons, Mixed), FlareInspectorTransform, FlareInspectorFill (F6b), FlareInspectorScene and FlareInspectorInstance (F6c), FlareInspectorTiming with FlareEasingPopover (F9), FlareOnionPopover (F10), FlareRecording (F5: the auto-key ring and dot) and the Inspector intent area.

relationships.description: reads properties and calls setValue, toggleKey, easing and onion methods
builds rows from the bar slider, KeyframeButton, InspectorHeader, PresetGrid and CurveEditor

components.name: Timeline and transport view
components.description: FlareTimeline (F7a: lanes, diamonds, scrub, readouts, empty text, a symbol's timeline), FlareTimelineEdit (F8: retime, delete, insert and remove frames, labels), FlareTransport (F7b: play, loop, step, the actual-fps pill) and the Timeline intent area.

relationships.description: calls key moves, removals and frame edits
reads the frame and calls play, pause, step

components.name: Layers and Library panels
components.description: FlareLayersPanel (F11a: scenes on top, then layers, on LayerList), FlareLibraryPanel (F12a: symbols, Convert to Symbol, place, edit in place), FlareBreadcrumb, FlareLibrarySwatches (F12b) and the Layers and Library intent areas.

relationships.description: switches Layers and Library with SegmentedTabs
lists scenes and layers in LayerList

components.name: Interactions editor view
components.description: FlareInteractions (F13a: the mode switch and the graph laid out by MachineLayout), FlareMachineInspector (F13b: state, transition, condition and inputs with inline refusals), FlareMachinePreview (F14: read-only stage, a control per input, the active state) and the Interactions intent area.

relationships.description: reads the layout and calls machine and preview methods

components.name: File and Edit views
components.description: FlareNewSheet (F11b: presets, fps, Create), FlareFilePanels (F17a: open and save panels, title, unsaved dot, Open Recent, close prompt), FlareOpenStatus (F17b: load progress, open errors, the text pill), FlarePasteboard (F18) and the File and Edit intent areas.

relationships.description: loads, saves and lists recent files
builds the new sheet from PresetGrid

components.name: Export sheet
components.description: FlareExportSheet (F15a: SVG, Lottie and PNG tabs, options, warnings, progress, Reveal), FlareExportStatus (F15b: failure, Cancel, Replace) and the Export intent area.

relationships.description: sets options and runs the export
hands StageRasterizer to a live export

components.name: Assist popover
components.description: FlareAssistPopover (F16a: prompt, progress, proposal rows in the AI-suggestion color, Preview, Accept, Reject), FlareAssistErrors (F16b) and the Assist intent area.

relationships.description: reads the proposal and calls generate, accept and reject

containers.name: SuiteUI
containers.description: The SuiteUI parts Flare builds from (line:suiteui owns them).

components.name: SuiteWindow shell
components.description: SuiteWindow with SidebarSection and SidebarRow, ToolbarGroup and the tokens: the shell Flare runs in until F1a moves it to EditorShell.

relationships.description: sizes and colors from the tokens

components.name: Tokens
components.description: Spacing, radius, size, type and color tokens: the column widths, window minimum and launch size, editor bar and panel widths and timeline sizes section 12.3 is written against.

components.name: Content surfaces
components.description: CanvasSurface and SurfaceCard: the artboard surface and scene card today's Flare window shows until F3a's stage replaces them.

relationships.description: sizes and colors from the tokens

components.name: Editor shell
components.description: EditorShell, EditorTopBar, EmptyStateView and ViewerStatusBar: the dark editor window with a hidden title bar. S9 adds the resizable timeline slot (inside EditorShell.swift).

components.name: Canvas viewport and marks
components.description: CanvasViewport, Ruler, ZoomMath and CanvasMarks: the stage's scroll and zoom, rulers, and selection handles drawn on the pixel grid.

components.name: Vector marks
components.description: S12: PathMarks, MotionPathMarks, GhostLayer and guide marks with smooth and corner anchors that differ in shape and handle hit rects of the hit token at any zoom.

components.name: Inspector parts
components.description: InspectorRows (the bar slider), StudioScrubRow, ScrubField, ScrubValue, NumericInput, KeyframeButton, InspectorHeader, InspectorAction, PresetGrid, ChipRow, ChoiceChips, ColorWell and CurveEditor.

components.name: Timeline strip
components.description: TimelineStrip with FrameMapping: lanes, key states, playhead and frame mapping shared by Flare and Halo; S10 restyles it.

components.name: Transport capsule
components.description: S7: TransportCapsule (play, loop, step, the fps pill) beside the restyled ViewerStatusBar pills.

components.name: Panel lists and tabs
components.description: SegmentedTabs: the right panel's tabs (Properties, Layers, Library).

components.name: Layer list
components.description: S15: LayerList, a non-split container over SidebarRow with sections, drag to reorder and rename.

components.name: Node graph
components.description: S14: NodeGraph, nodes at given positions, arrows with condition chips, warning badges.

components.name: Frame probe
components.description: QH-1: FrameProbe, input-to-display timings in frames late plus marks (preview before mouse-up, progress shown, animation ended, autosaved, state switched), exposed as suite.perf under a launch flag.

systems.name: creative-core
systems.description: FlareCore in qbtrix/creative-core. Paths are in that repo and list only the files flare.md's LC tasks name; status follows flare.md sections 0 and 2 (core main cfad97f, the revision dev resolves), not this repo's Sources/: an engine part that exists and an LC task extends is existing, one an LC task creates is planned.

containers.name: FlareCore library
containers.description: Animation document model, commands with undo, timeline, file format and export.

components.name: Document, engine, timeline and format
components.description: Document, scenes, layers, shapes, symbols and machines; the CommandEngine with undo, group and coalesceKey and the CommandRegistry; Geometry (LC-1 fixes the Transform doc comment); timeline sampling, Timeline.playbackFrame and easing; FlareFormat encode, decode and validate (pure, Sendable), with validateStateMachines. Paths are only the files the blueprint's LC tasks name.

components.name: Edit commands
components.description: The undoable edit commands (41 on core main cfad97f). LC-5, LC-7, LC-8, LC-10 and LC-12b extend them: owner-aware keyframe commands, SetShapeStroke, SetShapePath, DuplicateLayer, SetSceneCanvas, RenameScene, ReorderScene, RenameSymbol, and the SetKeyframe and MoveGuide merges.

components.name: Instance commands
components.description: LC-6 (Q5e): AddInstance, RemoveInstance, SetInstanceTransform (a drag merges into one entry) and SetInstancePlayback, with finite transform validation. Not on core main cfad97f.

components.name: Hit test and shape bounds
components.description: Today's hit test and shape bounds; LC-2 and LC-3 extend them with the zoom-aware tolerance and stroke-inclusive bounds.

components.name: Render list, hit query, world bounds, builders, onion
components.description: LC-1 Scene.renderList(at:symbols:) (G45), LC-2 the topmost hit with address and marquee, LC-3 world bounds with stroke, LC-4 path builders (rectangle with corner radius, ellipse as four cubics, polygon, star), LC-9 Layer.onionFrames (G46). None on core main cfad97f.

relationships.description: builds on the hit test and shape bounds

components.name: State machine commands and player
components.description: LC-11a the non-throwing StateMachine.issues(in:); LC-11b to LC-11e machine, state, transition and input commands; LC-12 MachinePlayer, the runtime the preview drives.

components.name: Exporters
components.description: SVGExporter and LottieExporter. LC-1 moves SVG onto the render list; LC-13 adds Lottie opacity, scale and rotation tracks (G52).

relationships.description: SVG walks the render list after LC-1
